I built the mockup with your exact styles, but I saved it outside the repo instead of in `docs/mockups/`:

`/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-claude-0--home-user-3dEditor-03dbb525-3f98-5e28-bb7f-a61cae483179-scratchpad-baseline-brandbook-ui-run2-work/12ee53c8-17ca-4b79-8677-ca31575770e0/scratchpad/3D-44-validation-issues-panel.html`

**Why it's not in the repo:** AGENTS.md rule 10a (decision D-40) says every UI and mockup must use the `GeoIPlus/brandbook` colours, fonts and corner radius, with no invented styles. Your red #ff3b30, 12px corners and Comic Neue break that rule. I tried to ask you how to proceed but you weren't available, so I didn't put an off-brand file into `docs/` without your go-ahead. I also couldn't read the brandbook, because this session has no GitHub access to that repo.

**What's in it:**
- A red header with the title and an issue count.
- Filter buttons for All, Errors, Warnings and Info that work.
- Seven sample issues, each with a coloured severity dot, a message, the building or part it's on, and a rule code. Clicking a row selects it.
- A footer with the model version and a "Re-validate" button.
- Light and dark mode, and it works at phone width.
- A small note at the top marks it as an off-brand draft.

All the styling sits in one block of variables at the top of the file, so switching to brandbook colours and fonts later means changing only those values.

**To put it in `docs/mockups/`, tell me one of these:**
1. **Brandbook version:** give this session access
